ai_offer.admission: launch-time global certificate with the class-specific bound; certificate rejection is an envelope observation, not a failure
ai_offer.rule: deterministic round-robin by one-based radio epoch

gates.crc_wire_contract: shared recovery serializes the verified CRC decision as 0=pass and 1=fail; raw cuPHY CRC bytes remain telemetry
gates.launch_revalidation: a certificate build above 5 ms is discarded and rebuilt from the current clock, for at most three attempts
gates.lifecycle: all CUDA IPC handles close before termination ack
gates.physical_start_guard: the Qwen worker starts no kernel after the committed lease's absolute latest-start time; a guarded non-launch safely retires the empty lease and is reported separately
gates.prestage: all input/oracle generation completes before readiness; each bank copy starts after prior D155 and completes before release
gates.response_fence: NRx and recovery responses are copied back to the worker and byte-compared before the completion doorbell
gates.safety: single commit and zero D155/path/lease/control violations
gates.transition: physical commit agrees with each observed outcome
gates.variable_context: each class follows the frozen round-robin offer, every physical Qwen completion stays within its class bound, and each class reaches the frozen minimum executed sample
gates.warm_recovery_lifecycle: every shared recovery context completes the full P2P input, window install, cuPHY decode, and P2P response path before readiness; preflight latency is reported but excluded from the warm service bound

mode.lifecycle: persistent endpoints with full P2P/window/cuPHY/response-path startup preflight; all synthetic channels and validation-only local oracles are built before readiness; only GPU-bank to stable IPC-buffer copy occurs in the post-expiry interval before the next P180 release

outcome_rule: Every CRC-correct result completed by 45 ms resolves its mandatory debt; every other accepted request executes shared recovery. Outcome counts are measurements, not pass criteria.
recovery_oracle: worker echoes the received input to the owner for exact comparison; shared CRC pass requires exact transmitted-TB payload while CRC fail is a valid radio failure result; local/shared decoder-class disagreement is reported separately and is not a transport error
scope: C159-Q2 variable-context P180 qualification, excluded from performance confidence intervals. Passing two nodes qualifies only the six frozen class bounds in this warm synthetic placement; online BurstGPT performance, WCET, cold/long-idle, production d_MAC and integrated faults remain UQ.
snr_assignment_rule: two +20 dB stable-success keys and two -8.75 dB transition keys; the transition point was fixed from the earlier independent Confirm18 500-sample sweep (conventional 0/500, NeuralRx 271/500)
